economy.summary: His campaign says the biggest issue facing families is the cost of everyday life, and cites bipartisan tax relief he passed for working families, small businesses, and seniors.
economy.short: Says everyday costs are the top issue; cites tax relief passed.

taxes.summary: Sponsored Senate Bill 527, the Commuter Tax Fairness Act, which would return earned income taxes paid by suburban commuters with Philadelphia-based employers to their home municipalities; he said the legislation is about protecting taxpayers and restoring fairness.
taxes.short: Sponsored bill returning commuter wage taxes to home municipalities.

abortion.summary: As a state representative he voted in December 2021 for Senate Bill 106, a proposed constitutional amendment stating there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion or other right relating to abortion. During his 2022 Senate campaign he said he supports a woman's right to choose an abortion up to the point of viability.
abortion.short: Voted for no-right-to-abortion amendment; later said supports choice to viability.

education.summary: His campaign says he worked with Republicans and Democrats to pass record funding for public schools and has consistently been a voice for investing in kids.
education.short: Says he helped pass record public school funding.

healthcare.summary: As chair of the Senate Institutional Sustainability and Innovation Committee, he says he is leading efforts to improve the efficiency, transparency, and long-term viability of Pennsylvania's health care and aging-care systems.
healthcare.short: Says he leads efforts on health care efficiency and viability.

energy.summary: His campaign says he has fought to lower energy costs and to end Pennsylvania's participation in the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI), which it says will save ratepayers money.
energy.short: Says he fought to lower energy costs, end RGGI participation.

guns.summary: Is advancing a crime package that includes mandatory jail time for felons illegally possessing firearms and increased penalties for gun store robberies; two of his bills in the package, on package theft and street racing, have been signed into law.
guns.short: Advances crime package: jail for felons with firearms, robbery penalties.

economy.summary: Her campaign says she will fight to lower costs and grow the local economy so residents have good-paying jobs that can support a family.
economy.short: Proposes lowering costs, growing economy for family-supporting jobs.

taxes.summary: In a January 2026 interview she criticized the state's four-month budget impasse for delaying essential services, pointing to school districts that considered closures during the delay.
taxes.short: Criticized state budget impasse for delaying essential services.

abortion.summary: In a January 2026 interview she named strengthening reproductive rights among her legislative priorities.
abortion.short: Names strengthening reproductive rights a legislative priority.

education.summary: Her campaign says she will fully fund public schools.
